talk:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: final production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for an existing desktop pet. Use the highest fidelity and care available.
Input image 1 is the canonical original Pace idle sprite. Preserve that SAME sprite's identity and pixel-art style, not a redrawn softer interpretation.
Primary request: Make an 8-frame seamless animation sheet of this cheetah with the requested small action.
Layout: exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, equal square cells, reading left to right then next row, no labels and no dividers; complete uncropped body in every cell. Aim for a 2048x1024 canvas (512-square cells). Each cell depicts the original 256-square reference enlarged EXACTLY 2x, so original 2x2 pixel blocks become hard square 4x4 blocks. This is artwork drawn on a 128x128 logical pixel grid per cell, then nearest-neighbor enlarged. All edges and interior boundaries align to that one grid. Preserve large, sparse pixel clusters and chunky staircase outlines; absolutely no fine pixel noise, thin texture, gradients, antialiasing, soft outlines, halos, smooth curves, or extra detail.
Palette: same limited original palette: outline #160404, gold #f9a80c, cream #fbeec5, red #dc0c1f, brown #54270b, highlight #fec310 with the same few secondary colors. Solid opaque colored pixels, completely transparent empty pixels. Binary alpha only: foreground alpha255, background alpha0.
Character invariants: exact original face, eyes, head size, neck, body width, limb thickness, tail, cheetah spots, red headband and red-white sneakers. Facing slightly right. Both original feet stay at the same anchored floor y=87.5% in every cell; same shoe centers. Head and body proportions must remain those of the reference, independent of action props. Original occupied standing height is 68.75% of cell. Keep the two original shoes, limbs and tail shape and position unchanged unless action specifically calls for a paw. Do not replace the character with a different cute cat. No writing, logos, shadows, sparkles, or background.
Transparency: genuinely transparent, preserve crisp binary alpha.
Action: talking with gentle mouth phonemes only. Frame sequence closed friendly smile, tiny mouth opening, small open oval, tiny opening, closed smile, small open oval, tiny opening, closed smile. Eyes remain original open friendly eyes; keep head contour, ears, body, hands, shoes, tail and pose pixel-identical throughout. Mouth shapes stay inside the original cream muzzle. No tongue sticking out or dramatic expression.
